name: Files
description: Files supports Store updates and a sideload path using fixed HTTPS .appinstaller URLs. The sideload service compares the manifest package/version and delegates installation to Windows PackageManager; lifecycle code invokes update checks at startup and periodically. Windows Authenticode enforcement is an OS/package-deployment boundary outside this source review.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Windows Store/package deployment signature enforcement, shipped MSIX metadata, and exact startup timing were not independently audited.
